name: Assassin
requirements: Must kill someone for no reason other than qualifying as an Assassin

features.name: Sneak Attack +1d6
features.summary: Gain 1d6 sneak attack damage.

features.name: Death Attack
features.summary: After studying a victim for 3 rounds, attempt a sneak attack that can kill or paralyze; save DC 10 + class level + Intelligence modifier.

features.name: Poison Use
features.summary: Never accidentally poison yourself while applying poison to a blade.

features.name: Poison Save +1
features.summary: Gain +1 on saving throws against poison, increasing every two levels.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.summary: Retain Dexterity to AC when flat-footed or attacked by an invisible foe.

features.name: Sneak Attack +2d6
features.summary: Increase Assassin sneak attack damage to 2d6.

features.name: Hidden Weapons
features.summary: Add Assassin level to Sleight of Hand checks made to conceal weapons.

features.name: True Death
features.summary: Creatures slain by Death Attack are harder to restore to life.

features.name: Poison Save +2
features.summary: Increase the saving throw bonus against poison to +2.

features.name: Sneak Attack +3d6
features.summary: Increase Assassin sneak attack damage to 3d6.

features.name: Improved Uncanny Dodge
features.summary: You can no longer be flanked except by a sufficiently higher-level rogue.

features.name: Quiet Death
features.summary: Make a Stealth check to prevent nearby creatures from noticing a successful Death Attack.

features.name: Poison Save +3
features.summary: Increase the saving throw bonus against poison to +3.

features.name: Sneak Attack +4d6
features.summary: Increase Assassin sneak attack damage to 4d6.

features.name: Hide in Plain Sight
features.summary: Use Stealth while observed when within 10 feet of an area of dim light.

features.name: Poison Save +4
features.summary: Increase the saving throw bonus against poison to +4.

features.name: Sneak Attack +5d6
features.summary: Increase Assassin sneak attack damage to 5d6.

features.name: Swift Death
features.summary: Attempt a Death Attack without studying the victim first.

features.name: Angel of Death
features.summary: A slain Death Attack victim can only be restored by especially powerful magic, and failed attempts may destroy the caster.

features.name: Poison Save +5
features.summary: Increase the saving throw bonus against poison to +5.
